jobs.description:
Are you motivated by leading people at the intersection of quality, laboratory systems and daily operations?

Join Bavarian Nordic as QC Manager for LIMS & Release and help your team deliver dependable system support and release activities that enable vaccine manufacturing.

**Your team and leadership environment

**LIMS & Release consists of 12 colleagues: four responsible for raw material release and Certificates of Analysis (CoAs), one dedicated IT Application Specialist, and seven working with daily LIMS activities and supporting the LabVantage project.

The team handles raw material release and CoAs, maintains LIMS methods and specifications, and provides day-to-day support to end-users, primarily within QC. This includes troubleshooting and resolving LIMS-related issues.

You will join a QC department of approximately 90 employees across six teams. Our Core Leadership Team of Senior Managers works closely with First-Line Managers, the Operational Excellence Partner and a Quality Integrator to develop people and processes and maintain strong quality oversight.

QC is undergoing significant change as we support increased production demands, improve efficiency and reduce lead times. As a first-line manager, you will translate changing priorities into clear direction while maintaining employee engagement, well-being and a strong quality mindset.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Lead a team with diverse responsibilities. Create shared direction across release activities, application support and daily LIMS work. Provide feedback, coaching and development planning so employees have the competencies and support they need to succeed.

• Ensure dependable daily delivery. Maintain an overview of workload, priorities and operational risks across raw material release, CoAs and LIMS support. Balance daily activities with the team’s contribution to the LabVantage project and respond to changing QC and manufacturing needs.

• Maintain compliant systems and processes. Ensure team activities comply with cGMP and the Bavarian Nordic Quality Management System. Promote data integrity, accurate documentation and inspection readiness across release processes and the maintenance of LIMS methods and specifications.

• Connect users and improve workflows. Coordinate with QC end-users, IT and manufacturing stakeholders to resolve issues and align priorities. Use data and digital tools to improve transparency and workflows, strengthening the team’s support for laboratory operations and reducing delays.

**Your profile

**

• You combine a people-focused leadership style with an understanding of how laboratory systems and release processes support quality operations. You can bring colleagues with different areas of expertise together and translate competing needs into clear priorities.

• A relevant scientific degree and experience from a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment, preferably within QC, laboratory support or a similar operational area.

• Experience with LIMS and an understanding of the importance of controlled methods, specifications and reliable laboratory data. Experience with LabVantage is an advantage.

• An understanding of raw material release and Certificates of Analysis, or relevant experience supporting comparable quality processes.

• A solid understanding of cGMP, data integrity and Quality Management Systems. Leadership experience is an advantage, together with the ability to develop people across different disciplines.

• A structured approach to prioritisation and improvement, with clear communication and the ability to collaborate across laboratory, IT and manufacturing functions.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic

**You will lead a team that connects laboratory systems, data and release activities with the needs of QC and manufacturing. The role offers broad cross-functional collaboration and the opportunity to influence processes, user support and digital ways of working.

You will be part of a leadership team that values employee development, coaching and collaboration. Through daily improvements and the team’s support for the LabVantage project, you can help shape how QC works while developing professionally in an international vaccine company.

**Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

**Apply by clicking the ‘APPLY’ button. We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your CV.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

**For us, it is all about improving and saving lives

**Improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines is at the heart of what we do at Bavarian Nordic. We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing and commercialisation of life-saving vaccines, and the largest pure-play vaccine company in the world.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

**About BLAST

**BLAST is a global competitive entertainment company working with some of the world's biggest game publishers, brands and entertainment properties to create world-class esports and live entertainment experiences.

We operate globally across multiple ecosystems, delivering everything from large-scale arena events and broadcasts to digital products and content.

Our values — Make it Bold, Make it Together and Make it Happen — shape how we work, collaborate and deliver.

**Welcome to the Global Mobility Team at BLAST!

**At BLAST, we bring people together - across borders, stages, and time zones. Now we're looking for a Global Mobility Consultant to join our team and help us ensure that our people can thrive wherever in the world our events take them.

You'll be part of a small but passionate team of colleagues, working closely with People and Culture, Travel, Finance, Legal, and Live Events to build and run a world-class mobility framework that supports BLAST's global growth.

**What You'll Be Doing - Your Impact

**As our new Global Mobility Consultant, you'll make it easier for people to move across borders with confidence - whether they're employees, freelancers, or part of our extended network.

**Your key responsibilities include:

**

• Acting as an advisor on international hires and postings

• Coordinating with P&O, Payroll, and external vendors (legal, tax, relocation)

• Managing work permit and visa applications, incl. compliance and documentation

• Providing guidance to cross-border employees and freelancers

• Drafting invitation and support letters

• Supporting the expansion of our Global Mobility hub and processes

• Liaising with specialised legal counsels as needed

• Handling admin tasks like budget tracking, PO creation, and updating WIPS

• Taking on other ad hoc tasks as the need arises - flexibility is key!

• Managing portfolio-wide shared services scope across key global operational regions

• Ensuring close cross-departmental collaboration with Travel, People Operations, and Legal

• Serving as the primary coordination point for all international mobility queries and escalation

• Providing dedicated talent and event-specific support for global tournament operations

• Driving process scalability and documentation across global mobility workflows

• High-Volume Event Scaling, managing visa and immigration logistics for large-scale international tournaments involving up to 400 personnel per event (including Third-Country Nationals, employees, and freelancers)

• Reviewing agreements with local partners and drafting special clauses regarding visa support, including negotiating terms, intervention costs, sourcing local vendors/counsel, and handling contract negotiations, term reviews, and cost analysis

• Direct interaction and coordination with immigration authorities, government departments, and local regulatory bodies, rather than solely liaising with external legal counsel

• Local Entity Compliance & Corporate Service Provider Coordination, overseeing local corporate compliance requirements such as employer registrations, and local tax/social security considerations

**Who You Are - To Succeed In This Role

**You're an excellent communicator, a proactive problem-solver, and a trusted partner to your colleagues. You thrive in a dynamic environment, love the details, and care about creating smooth experiences for people on the move.

**Requirements

****Experience:

**

• A degree in HR, Business Administration, Legal - or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of experience with international assignments and cross-border employment particularly in relation to North America and Asia

• Strong understanding of mobility processes and compliance

• Solid experience working with Excel (e.g. data management, formulas, reporting) Proficiency in tools like Smartsheet, Google Sheets, and AI and automation tools and platforms

• Experience providing team leadership, guidance, and mentorship within a small team environment

• Previous background in the sports, entertainment, or fast-paced live events industry, given the scale of international tournaments

• Demonstrated flexibility, interpretation, and creativity in navigating complex or ambiguous visa regulations across global destinations lacking standardized visa categories

• Experience with budget tracking, cost control, PO creation, and managing financial considerations related to global mobility and travel

• Proven ability to manage high-pressure situations, tight event deadlines, and complex logistical escalations independently

• Strong cross functional stakeholder engagement skills to coordinate seamlessly across all the internal Blast teams as well as external vendors

• Willingness to work flexible hours during major events or travel occasionally between the London and Copenhagen offices

**Benefits

****What We Offer - Life at BLAST

**

• At BLAST, you'll join a creative, collaborative, and international environment where no two days are the same. We're proud of our culture - one where people are seen, heard, and encouraged to bring ideas forward

**Here's a glimpse of what you'll get:

**

• A fast-paced and supportive workplace

• Great colleagues

• Flexible working conditions

• Centrally located office in Copenhagen

• Personal and professional development opportunities

• Friday bars, social events, and access to world-class esports action

Ready to join us?

We're excited to meet you. Apply now and help us shape the future of Global Mobility at BLAST

The Company

Makin A/S develops machine control systems for earthmoving equipment, with a clear ambition to make a noticeable impact in the market. Since our establishment in 2018, we have built one of the preferred machine control systems in Scandinavia and continue to expand into new markets. We are now looking for a new colleague to join our Support Team.

Makin’s support organization is based in Odense, Denmark, and you will work closely with the team here. The position offers hybrid flexibility, but preferably you will be able to spend weekly time at the office. We collaborate closely with our distributor and key account network - both in developing new solutions and in supporting daily operations.

Within the Support Team, we value initiative, teamwork, a sense of humor, and a strong dedication to customer success.

The Position

We support our international distributors and key accounts with everything they need to grow their markets—troubleshooting, training, spare parts, service offerings, technical documentation, e-learning, and more.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Assisting distributors and key accounts with remote troubleshooting of software solutions and hardware

• Driving product adoption among existing distributors through training and knowledge sharing

• Capturing and communicating customer needs across the organization

• Creating and maintaining content for our knowledge base

• Visit distributors and key accounts for on-site training and occasional troubleshooting.

The Candidate

You have a relevant technical background that enables you to collaborate with technicians and engineers to find effective solutions. Your experience may come from technical support, customer success management, or similar role.

Experience with automation, machine control, or digital construction is preferred.

You should expect some travelling to our closest partners.

Qualifications:

• Proven ability to build and maintain strong partnerships

• Excellent communication skills and a structured approach to work

• Fluency in English required; additional languages are an advantage

• 3–5 years of relevant experience

• Genuine curiosity and interest in working with both hardware and software

What We Offer

You will join a team of highly skilled colleagues in an environment where customer needs guide our work and collaboration is key. At Makin, we value autonomy—so you should be both disciplined and structured in your approach.

Interested?

If this sounds like a good match, please submit your CV via the Apply-link on this page.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis until we find the right candidate.

If you have any questions about the position or the company, feel free to contact:

Hanne Hansen

+45 31 37 48 30

Hanne.hansen@makin3d.com

jobs.occupation: International Customer Success Manager for a Copenhagen grid-tech start-up
jobs.description:
Are you a customer-facing project manager who thrives on paving the way to success for B2B customers? Do you speak fluent German and English – and perhaps Spanish/Italian? Do you see yourself in a fast-growing start-up with an international team that is securing critical electrical infrastructure?

Then you could be Oktogrid’s new Customer Success Manager!

About Oktogrid

Oktogrid helps secure critical infrastructure by bringing power transformers online for higher reliability and a more sustainable operation. Oktogrid’s sensor solution significantly accelerates the path to getting access to the right data to support operators with the necessary insights for their decision-making.

Founded in 2020. Oktogrid has the continued backing of major European investors, including ABB Electrification and Elewit Ventures, and works with a wide range of grid operators across Europe. The company has 14 employees, most of whom are based at the Copenhagen office, with sales colleagues based in Germany and the Netherlands. Oktogrid also works with an international development team. English is the company language.

About the role

Reporting directly to the CEO, who also heads up sales, you will ensure that Oktogrid’s customers get off to a strong start and support them on their journey as they continue to benefit of the value from the solution. As the Customer Success Manager, you will follow each new customer closely throughout the first 3-9 months – from installation workshops to confidently onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform.

You will remain their trusted point of contact for the entire customer journey, while your experience in project coordination will ensure that the right expertise from your colleagues is involved whenever needed. Your job is not to acquire new customers, but to build strong relationships with existing ones, identify new needs and plant the seeds for further collaboration. You will be based at the Copenhagen office, with occasional travel.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Running a structured onboarding process for new customers – from project kick-off workshops to onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform

• 
Following up closely with customers and holding regular check-ins to ensure that they get the value they expect

• 
Owning a portfolio of Danish and international customers, with a focus on German-speaking markets

• 
Engaging with a rich map of stakeholders within each customer organisation – for example, the operations managers in each region – so that the solution becomes part of their day-to-day work

• 
Bringing in Oktogrid’s technical experts when customers need in-depth answers about transformers, deeper data analytics or software integrations

• 
Identifying new needs and opportunities – such as additional analytics modules and reports – and passing them on to the product and operations teams

• 
Capturing customer feedback and success stories for Product and Marketing

• 
Building and continuously improving Oktogrid’s Customer Success process and playbook

About you

A background in utilities or within energy is a plus, but not a requirement – Oktogrid’s experts are at hand when in-depth expertise is needed. What matters most is that you are excellent at building trust, maintaining close dialogue with customers and picking up on when to involve your extended team at Oktogrid. Having previously worked within energy, telecoms, IT, SaaS or other B2B industries in which you have delivered complex solutions to large customers are relevant fields of experience. We envisage that you have:

• 
5-10 years’ experience in Customer Success or related customer-facing roles with B2B customers

• 
Experience of working with structured customer processes – ideally gained in a medium-sized company where you have had broad responsibility

• 
Experience in delivering complex solutions and managing long-term customer relationships, rather than having ambitions of driving transactional sales

• 
Technical understanding and the ability to explain complex solutions clearly to expert as well as non-expert stakeholders

• 
A proactive approach – you bring your own ideas to the table and take ownership of improving the way things are done

• 
Genuine curiosity about customers’ needs – you spot opportunities that create further value for them

• 
The drive to succeed in a fast-growing start-up as part of a high-performing, international team – and a preference for working from the office in close contact with customers and colleagues

• 
Fluent in German and English, written and spoken. Spanish and Italian would be a strong advantage, as many customers prefer to communicate in their own language

• 
Experience with utilities and an understanding of asset management practices would be an advantage, but is not a requirement

• 
A valid permit to live and work in Denmark (EU/EEA citizenship or a Danish work permit)

Oktogrid offers

• 
A key role with real influence in a company actively driving a meaningful climate impact

• 
Office-based work with flexible working hours, the option of working from home one day a week and a partly paid company lunch scheme every day

• 
A modern office space in Copenhagen at the border between Vesterbro and Frederiksberg, located close to green areas and a vibrant hub where innovation meets great city culture

• 
A salary based on qualifications, and a company-wide bonus scheme

Interested?

Apply as soon as possible by clicking the application button and uploading your CV and, if you wish, a cover letter, both in English.

If you have any questions, please contact Martin Nielsen, Headhunter & Partner at Landau Headhunting, on +45 8122 8180. Landau Headhunting is managing the recruitment process on behalf of Oktogrid, so please direct all enquiries to us. We will review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you! Read more about Oktogrid at https://oktogrid.io

_Do you want to be the commercial anchor between our customers and our product offerings in our Heat/Cooling Division? Do you enjoy connecting customer needs with commercial opportunities and technical possibilities? Do you want to help shape smart metering products and solutions that accelerate the green transition?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Senior Commercial Product Manager for Hardware Solutions, you will work cross functionally on product lifecycle optimization of our Heating and Cooling solutions to align product development with market demands, customer needs, and revenue goals. To do so, you will be responsible for driving the commercial aspects of our product portfolio, including product launches and lifecycle management.

More specifically, you will be:

• Managing the product lifecycle from idea to end-of-life

• Driving product discovery and portfolio optimization projects in close collaboration with our customers, Sales and Marketing

• Owning the business case and commercial roadmap for hardware products, including pricing, to ensure profitability and market fit

• Working with colleagues across the organization, training Sales and Customer Support to succeed

• Challenging status quo to ensure continuity of commercially viable solutions

You will be at the forefront of decision-making, steering the direction of our products and solutions. In this role, you will have the mandate to act, and the responsibility needed to make impactful decisions that help our customers adapt to a more sustainable future.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Commercial Product Management, you will become part of a team of highly skilled colleagues who work every day to bring smart metering solutions and services to our markets. The Commercial Product Management team combines strong commercial capabilities with a solid technical understanding of our solutions to drive profitability and help our customers succeed in energy efficiency and the green transition.

The team is part of the Product Management organization for Heat/Cooling products and solutions and brings together colleagues with strong technical, commercial and strategic expertise. This diversity helps us achieve a high level of quality and challenge status quo, which is something we value highly in our department.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for an ambitious and passionate colleague who brings a profound drive to deliver winning and value-adding solutions to the green transition. You have a natural drive and an “outside in” perspective in everything you do. Ideally, you bring experience of working in a matrix, from an international setting.

To succeed in this role, we envision that you:

• Have experience working at the intersection of customers, business, technology and products, driving decisions across functions and organizational levels

• Have a great commercial understanding combined with a high technical interest – or vice versa

• Can apply Product Management disciplines to translate customer and market insights into successful products

• Are an effective communicator who excels in building and maintaining strong relationships both internally and with customers

• Can translate technical information to a broad audience

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Commercial Product Management, Emil Warncke on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Opportunity

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

Key responsibilities

• You will have an end-to-end responsibility, accountability and handling entire demand to delivery process for allocated set of Maersk Line vessels and ensure the 4R Principle – Right price, Right Place, Right Time and Right Quantity.

• Running the RFQ process with non-contracted suppliers for optimal deliveries.

• Follow Procure to Pay process (PTP) for timely payments to all vendors and handle invoices with discrepancies.

• Support Stakeholders with technical organizations through daily interactions and addressing their concerns in a timely manner. Must have the sense of urgency to address all pressing matters with key stakeholders.

• To be familiar with IT platform / system operation with good knowledge to gain maximum output of offered tools and ensure Process compliance.

• Support Senior Buyers in driving the operational Performance of the Team

• Share inputs towards assigned team Initiatives around Category Strategies. Should be keen on learning and acquiring right skill set.

• Support with implementing automation as part of the Digital Agenda.

• Support Senior colleagues with Supplier Performance Management tasks.

• Share inputs with Master data teams to optimize back-end data quality.

• Assist Senior colleagues with the transactional support around Team initiatives & drives.

• Always follow the Maersk’s carbon neutral initiative to minimize the carbon emission in our supply chains.

We are looking for

This position is well-suited to an individual with strong interpersonal skills, capable of developing and influencing internal and external relationships. The ideal candidate will come with:

• 5+ years of experience in procurement domain

• A proven track record of planning and supply chain in an international matrix organization.

• Has a strong mindset with a natural focus on achieving the most cost-effective solutions for the business.

• Strong time management and ability to prioritize under ambitious timelines

• Experience in the marine industry will be considered an advantage

• An educational background in relevant fields of Engineering and/or a Masters in Supply Chain or Operations Management

Furthermore you:

• Are a self-driven team player, who understands the importance of stakeholder management, can build rapport at all levels even in challenging situations, and can encourage and influence others without authority

• Have an entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical skills.

• Can take ownership, work independently in a structured manner, and achieve concrete results.

• You can handle risks and uncertainties and are flexible in adapting when priorities change. You feel comfortable challenging the status quo and are motivated to lead change.

• Are an excellent communicator in English both in writing and in speaking.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing  accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

Department: Operations (Engineering Services & Customer Support)

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines, so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior IoT Solutions Engineer to join Engineering Services, the team that takes on the technical problems that fall outside what our product and Support handle today. You’ll look at a PLC, a sensor, or a 20-year-old CNC and work out how to get its data into Factbird. Sales and Support turn to you when the answer is “it depends,” and you turn that into a clear yes, no, or “here’s how.” Then you write it down so the next person doesn’t need to ask.

****About the role

**Engineering Services solves the hardest technical problems, documents them, and shares the knowledge, so Factbird gets smarter and the same problem doesn’t come back. You’ll answer feasibility questions before deals close, design and build custom solutions, and fix the cross-domain problems no other team can place.

**

The team mission we are on: Engineering Services is a small team of experts finding solutions to a wide variety of challenges. In pre-sales we are supporting our AE's and Solution Consultants with feasibility testing the most complex customer setups or requirements. Often directly with the customers and their technical teams. In post-sales we collaborate with Cloud, FW and HW teams, and build and support a range of custom solutions. Our core mission is to increase documentation, standardization and empowering our colleagues in both pre- and post-sales roles to server the customers in the most technical cases.

**What You'll Do

**

• Answer feasibility questions from Sales: can we connect this machine, PLC, or sensor, and how

• Design and build custom solutions: logic boxes, signal converters, IO-Link modules, EDGE flows, and Factbird® powered by OMRON NX1 programs that fill gaps the cloud platform can’t handle yet.

• Design the integration: map the customer’s OT/IT environment and plan the data sources, tag structures, transformations, and security.

• Root cause troubleshooting in live production. Smaller share of time, highest stakes

• Document everything you build and fix: Solution Records, runbooks, and wiring guides for customers and internal teams, clear enough that someone else can pick it up. Version and back up every configuration.

• Bench-test hardware before it ships, test the full data flow end to end (including failure recovery and restarts), and hand hardware to Logistics with a clear packing list.

• Integrate customer systems through Kepware, Ignition, OPC UA, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and Node-RED.

• Share what you know: help Support, Solution Consultants, and Hardware handle more on their own.

• Streamline as you go: spot repeat work and clunky processes, and fix them or flag them. Build templates and scripts that make the next delivery faster.

• Turn repeat workarounds into product input with a business case, so the workaround can disappear.

• Join customer and prospect calls as the technical voice alongside Solution Consultants and Account Managers.

**About you

**You’re an experienced industrial automation engineer, as happy with a screwdriver as with a terminal. You know how factories work, and you’re comfortable saying “not directly, but here’s the route.”

You document like the next person depends on it, because they do. You can’t leave a clunky process alone: you always have an eye on how to make things simpler and more repeatable.

You’re flexible and self-directed: you take a high level of accountability and ownership. You can prioritize and deliver without daily supervision, and you troubleshoot systematically when things get ambiguous. The work changes week to week, and the team’s shape will keep evolving as Factbird grows. You’re happy to do what’s needed today while helping move things in a more scalable direction.

You love being the expert, but you equally love teaching others and making the teams around you smarter. And most of all, you care about making the answer simple for whoever asked.

Requirements:

• A bachelor's degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• At least 5 years in industrial automation or controls engineering, including hands-on work on the shop floor (7+ years preferred).

• Hands-on PLC experience with at least one major vendor, e.g. Siemens, Omron, or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.

• Solid understanding of industrial protocols, e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT.

• Working knowledge of sensors and signals, like digital, analog (4–20 mA, 0–10 V), IO-Link, PNP/NPN, and energy metering.

• Root cause analysis across hardware, networks, and software in live production environments.

• Field experience commissioning or troubleshooting equipment in live plants.

• Comfortable troubleshooting site networks, e.g. IP setup, routers, SIMs, and firewalls.

• A clear communicator in English who can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

• A strong documentation habit: when you build it, you write it down.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

jobs.occupation: Global Service Specialist - DO/Emico, Flotation PCV, DSG-3
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Global Service Specialist – DO/EIMCO, Flotation, PCV, DSG

****Position Summary

**FLS is seeking a highly skilled and professional Global Service Specialist to support the erection, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and operational startup of commercial and industrial separation equipment. This role focuses primarily on mechanical work and Installation & Commissioning (I&C) activities for thickeners and flotation cells, with additional responsibility for equipment such as clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, and agitated tanks.

jobs.description:
PharmaRelations is the Nordic market leader in talent services for the life science industry. We specialize in partnering with some of the most innovative and successful organizations across the Nordic life science sector. We create value for both clients and candidates through our consultancy services, outsourcing solutions, and recruitment of specialists and leaders.

We are a Nordic organization with over 200 colleagues and with offices in Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland. PharmaRelations is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.

PharmaRelations is now looking for a Head of Clinical Operations in Denmark who wants to continue to build and develop our business in Denmark and south of Sweden (Öresundsregionen). The Clinical Development business unit at PharmaRelations focus on ad-hoc support, consultant services as well as outsourcing within clinical trials, to our clients in the Life Science Industry.

You will be responsible for sales as well as working approximately half of your time operationally in clincal trial assignments. You will also be part of the Nordic Leadership Team for Clinical Development. The role reports to the Nordic Head of Clinical Development and can be based in the broader Copenhagen area.

We offer you an inspiring and engaging place to work with great possibility to influence our business as well as to develop professionally moving forward.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for you with solid experience from working with clinical trials and sponsor oversight in the Life Science Industry. It will be an advantage if you have also experience from a consultancy company. Most importantly, you have a passion for sales and building strong and long-lasting relationships. You speak and write English as well as Danish or Swedish fluently.

As you will continue to build our team of consultants within Clinical development, an interest in leadership and personnel responsibility will be key, as the role will gradually develop into a line manager position with less operational assignments.

To thrive at PharmaRelations and with our clients, we believe that you are a non-prestigious person who is happy to contribute to a good atmosphere in the workplace. Communication and collaboration with customers and colleagues come naturally to you, and you enjoy working both independently and in teams.

Why?

Together with you, we want to continue building our Clinical Development business unit in the Nordics. You will have the chance to build your own team of consultants as well as driving sales and business development within our area, together with the Nordic team.

You will get the chance to develop your skills, and to work with a team of highly intelligent, innovative, and passionate experts across the Nordics. PharmaRelations offer a place where there is room for you to excel, be valued and make a difference. Not just to us, but ultimately indirectly to the patients’ lives we help improve and save every day by serving the Life Science Industry.

At PharmaRelations we also aim to become the best place to work within Nordic Life Science Industry. We follow Great Place to Work’s model, and our definition of “the best” is to get the highest results among all Nordic Life Science companies in the GPTW model. It is a challenging goal, but we strive to always continue to challenge ourselves to continuously improve and become an even better employer each year.

What does the best place to work mean to you?

Our people make the difference. We are committed to an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to succeed. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background, identity, or experience.

If you believe your background and expertise align with our requirements, we encourage you to submit your application by clicking the “Apply” button on our home page, or via the shown link.

Applications will be reviewed on a continuous basis in our search for the right candidate. The position will remain open until we have received enough qualified applications. Early applications are therefore encouraged.

Shape the Future of Privacy

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Office of AI

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

About the role

You are the senior technical owner of AI enablement at Usercentrics: the person who takes the hardest department AI builds, the deepest platform problems, and the technical bar the rest of the enablement track works to.

The role has two layers, and we mean both. At the department layer, you do what every AI Enablement Engineer does, prototyping and shipping AI applications for Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and beyond, but you take the hardest ones yourself and set the pattern the others follow. At the platform layer, you own the infrastructure that makes all of that possible: the LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, evaluation frameworks, and the engineering standards product teams build against.

What you would be walking into: a real internal AI platform already adopted across the company, the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, a skill hub, usage analytics, and low-code automation. The next layer is largely open. A gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you would have a strong say in what gets built and in what order. Real adoption already exists, which is a rarer starting point than a blank slate.

The role asks for two things at once. You are a deeply technical engineer who can architect and build these systems hands-on, at the hardest end of the department builds and the platform layer both. And you build a technical community: you raise the bar across the Enablement Engineers and beyond through education, mentoring, and reusable patterns. If you only have one of these, this is probably not your role.

You will work alongside the AI Enablement Lead, who owns the non-technical adoption pillar (the champion network, AI literacy, and the cross-department use-case pipeline). Your focus is the engineering depth behind that pipeline, from the department app someone is using tomorrow to the platform layer that will still be standing in two years.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be the most senior engineer on the enablement track and the technical bar would be yours to set.

Requirements

What you will do

• Take on the hardest department AI application builds yourself, and set the technical pattern the AI Enablement Engineers work to

• Own the platform layer that supports every department build: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you help decide what they are

• Own the internal AI marketplace: keep the cross-departmental AI apps secure, maintained, and governed as the number of them grows

• Own evaluation frameworks and the guardrails that let the team move fast without shipping unreliable AI: output quality, hallucination detection, regression testing

• Set the engineering standards and integration patterns for AI that product and department teams build against

• Raise the engineering bar across the org. Run technical education and enablement for engineers, document reusable patterns, and mentor builders beyond your own team

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead, Security, and Platform Engineering to ship AI capabilities that are safe, governed, and adopted

• Translate company-wide AI goals into concrete engineering roadmaps and measurable outcomes

What you bring

• 8+ years in software engineering, with significant time at staff level owning complex systems end to end

• Staff-level technical depth. You can own the most complex problems on the enablement track, from a department build to platform infrastructure, and lead by being the strongest engineer in the room

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped production systems with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, or applied ML yourself, at both application and infrastructure layers

• A strong engineering foundation in distributed systems, backend platform design, and cloud architecture (Azure or GCP), with the judgement to set standards others follow

• A track record of mentoring senior engineers and unblocking ambiguous architecture without heavy process overhead

• A real technical-community or education background. You have taught, mentored at scale, run developer communities, written the docs, or evangelised technology to engineers beyond your own team

• Clear, direct communication, strong in async and written form. You align stakeholders across security, platform, and product without slowing the team down

Nice to have

• Experience with multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP) and modern DevOps practices

• Background in AI governance, evaluation, or responsible AI deployment

• Experience operating in a regulated or privacy-focused domain

• Recognition as a developer advocate, community leader, conference speaker, or similar (e.g. Google Developer Expert)

• Former founder or CTO experience, comfortable owning ambiguity end to end

Benefits

Why join Usercentrics?

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

• Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved. We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all departments enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York.

Some of our benefits

• 
Development budget for every employee: €800 per year

• 
Job-related language courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish, etc.): €350 per year

• 
Hybrid working policy with the option to take a workcation (up to 60 days per year)

• 
Online yoga sessions

• 
Events: team buildings, happy hours, parties/get-togethers, and occasional company-covered breakfasts or lunches (in-office, across offices, online, and in person)

• 
Gifts: we celebrate life and work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new baby arrivals, and similar occasions)

• 
Snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We strive to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment (DEI) where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that our different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are our greatest strengths — so we are committed to building with them as we foster innovation and drive our success.

We recognize that this is an ongoing journey. We commit to listening and to continuous learning, growth, and improvement. By embracing DEI principles, we will create a more just and equitable society, and we are proud to play our part in making this vision a reality.

We are #BetterTogether.

**You will act as both writer and project manager, driving regulatory documents from first plan to final version.

• Lead the planning, development and oversight of regulatory documents, including study protocols, informed consent forms, investigator’s brochures, clinical summaries, paediatric plans, briefing packages and responses to health agency questions.

• Represent Regulatory Scientific Writing (RSW) on cross-functional project teams, advising on how to plan regulatory documents, what they require and how best to present the data.

• Work with colleagues across Research & Development to make sure source information and data are reported accurately and completely, and interpreted scientifically.

• Keep documents on track against project timelines and business needs.

• Share better practices and look for simpler ways of working.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join RSW, the medical writing function at Novo, with 200+ medical writers worldwide. RSW is part of Research & Development (R&D) and anchored together with Regulatory and Quality functional areas. R&D manages clinical drug development and submissions to health authorities worldwide, from early development to market authorisation. RSW covers all clinical drug development projects across therapy areas.

In project teams, your closest partners will be colleagues in Medical & Science, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics and Pharmacovigilance, among others. You will work with colleagues in Denmark and abroad, and your clarity around timelines and data presentation will help these teams make decisions and move forward together. The position is office-based in Søborg, Denmark.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a one-year temporary position. You will join a supportive culture that values continuous learning, being bold and striving for simplicity. You will be trusted to own your documents and make your voice heard in cross-functional teams, while growing your expertise alongside colleagues across R&D and the wider medical writing community.

**Salary

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200.00 - 838,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Incentives And Benefits

**The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Contact

**For further information about the position, please contact **Grith Møller (+45 3079 6487) and Jasper Neergaard Jacobsen (+45 3079 4897)

****Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex clinical data into clear communication that moves development forward, apply for the Experienced Medical Writer role by 15 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences in your CV about why you are applying. To keep the recruitment process efficient and fair, please do not include a photo in your CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

• Are you commercially minded and interested in e-commerce and online sales?

• Do you enjoy working with data and turning insights into commercial opportunities?

• Do you want to play an important role in growing HAY’s online footprint?

If yes, please read on!

ONLINE SALES COORDINATOR

Based out of Horsens

At our office facilities by the harbor edge in Horsens, you will become part of an energetic office community, consisting of approx. 100 colleagues looking forward to welcoming you to the team.

About the job

We’re looking for an Online Sales Coordinator to support and develop our online business with key retail partners. You will monitor online sales and product performance, identify commercial opportunities and help ensure that the right products are available and presented in the best possible way across our online sales channels. Working closely with internal teams and online dealers, you will turn data and insights into concrete actions that support sales performance.

More specifically, your tasks will include:

• Monitor online sales and product performance: Follow dealer online sales, stock levels, sell-through and product performance, and identify lost sales, replenishment opportunities and other opportunities to improve online sales

• Optimize product availability and presentation: Ensure key products are available, visible and correctly presented across relevant online sales channels

• Coordinate product information and availability: Coordinate orders, product data, prices, content, digital assets and delivery information, and follow up on availability, replenishment and ETAs

• Support assortment and commercial activities: Provide input on assortment optimization based on product performance and demand, and coordinate online product launches, campaigns and other commercial activities

• Turn data into action: Prepare reports and overviews on online sales, stock and product performance, and turn data and insights from relevant systems and AI tools into actionable recommendations

• Coordinate and collaborate across teams: Work closely with relevant internal teams to align product availability, commercial priorities and online presentation, and ensure structured communication with relevant dealers

• Optimize ways of working: Maintain a structured overview of ongoing activities and contribute to improving processes and workflows within online sales

Are you the Online Sales Coordinator we are looking for?

Role expectations

• As a person, you are outgoing, proactive and a strong communicator

• You are commercially minded and curious, with an interest in understanding what drives online sales

• You are independent, structured and able to keep your focus

• You are solution-oriented and comfortable turning insights into action

• You thrive with both analytical and routine tasks and have an eye for detail

• As our new colleague, you will become part of a community where we cherish our culture and the pace is always high – therefore it is important that you have a desire to be part of the social community that exists across departments, age groups and backgrounds

Experience required

• Ideally, you have experience from a coordinating or commercially oriented role within e-commerce, online sales or wholesale

• You have a good understanding of e-commerce and an interest in online sales and commercial performance

• You are comfortable working with data and using it to identify opportunities

• You are a confident Excel user and comfortable working across different IT systems

• Experience with product data, PIM systems and AI tools is an advantage

• You are fluent in Danish and English, both spoken and written

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV (preferably in English) as soon as possible and no later 11 November 2026. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Senior Manager, Stine Dahl at stine.dahl@hay.com or Recruiter, John Cain at john_cain@hermanmiller.com.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**In this role, you will own and develop our Reward and benefits processes across the company. The scope includes our annual pay review, market benchmarking, benefits and incentive schemes, job architecture, and Rewards activities.

This role would suit a proactive Rewards professional who has previously perhaps worked in a team and is looking for their first stand alone. The expectations on you are to further develop and optimise our recently implemented rewards solutions, in particular in Workday, and support all of the company's rewards processes.

Our company is evolving fast and so an enjoyment of a dynamic and demanding environment with a delivery focus is essential for success.

**What You Will Do

**

• Developing Rewards in Workday to operate efficiently.

• Carrying out benchmarking and updating of pay against the job architecture

• Lead the annual pay-review process across the business.

• Maintaining up to date job architecture with regular reviews to ensure embedded in the organisation

• Develop and maintain our benefit and incentive programmes.

• Compiling required reports and data for pay budgeting, reviewing and equal pay requirements globally

• Continues to ensure that pay and benefits attract the highest calibre of talent available in our markets

**Essential

****What you bring

**

• Three to four years of hands-on experience in reward, compensation, benefits, or a closely related field that includes pay reviews, market benchmarking, benefits, incentive schemes, and job architecture.

• Experience managing reward or benefit activities across different countries, including cross-border pay equity and benefit plans.

• Hands-on experience using Mercer / Mercer Win benchmarking data and tools to compare jobs and pay across different markets.

• Professional fluency in English.

**You will work closely with HR Directors, HR colleagues, business leaders, and managers across the organisation. Together, you will support a clear understanding of our reward frameworks and help managers make consistent reward decisions.The role also involves maintaining relationships with external reward groups and professional networks.

**What We Offer

**We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

An annual bonus program

25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months

Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning

Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination

Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen

Social activities through our Employee Association

**Practical Information

**Location: Birkerød, Denmark

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer to keep the fun going for years to come.

As a Game Engineer on Subway Surfers, you’ll work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to take ideas from concept through implementation and into the hands of the above-mentioned hundreds of millions of players. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve both the game and the way we build it.

Working with LiveOps lets you get instant feedback on your work - working with one of the largest LiveOps games makes it unique. Read below and get in touch!

**Responsibilities

**

• Develop and maintain gameplay features, systems, and content for Subway Surfers using Unity and C#

• Collaborate with Designers, Artists, and other Engineers to take features from concept through implementation and release

• Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase

• Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality

• Debug and resolve technical issues across gameplay systems and live features

• Contribute to improving the tools, workflows, and development practices used by the team

Life at SYBO

• In your first month, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner, Engineers, Designers, and Artists on the game team, familiarize yourself with the codebase and development pipeline, and start contributing to your first features.

• In your first three months, you’ll be contributing independently to features and content and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers codebase.

• In your first twelve months, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to the development of features and content from planning through release and helping shape technical solutions for the game - and you’ve received plenty of player feedback on things you’ve worked on!

**Requirements

**

• Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#

• Professional experience developing games, ideally on mobile

• Solid hands-on experience with Unity

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns

• Experience collaborating with multiple disciplines to develop and deliver game features

• Experience working with version control systems such as Git

• Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

• Experience working on a live game and regularly shipping new features and content

• Experience developing or integrating client/server features and backend services

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant External Reporting – Offshore Wind Industry
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about external reporting and consolidation activities? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading – Cadeler is looking for a Student Assistant External Reporting with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. We are part of an industry that is now, more than ever, both relevant and play a critical role in the energy transition with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we! We are now looking for a Student Assistant External Reporting to help support the team in the collection, validation, and consolidation of data.

**What will you do?

**As our new Student Assistant External Reporting, you will assist in preparing and maintaining reporting materials.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Assist in preparing and maintaining reporting materials, templates and documentation.

• Perform data quality checks to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness of reported information.

• Support the preparation of external financial and sustainability reports.

• Assist with ad hoc analyses and reporting-related tasks.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting processes and workflows.

**To succeed in this role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means you will have a natural interest and care for the environment and our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Your environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for someone with numeric and data-handling skills, who thrives in a collaborative environment with many interfaces.

We think you will be a good match if you:

• Currently enrolled in, or planning to enrol in, a Bachelor's or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Sustainability or a related field.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with PowerPoint is an advantage.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English; Danish language skills are a plus.

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler is headquartered in Copenhagen, but we also have offices in Vejle, UK, and Taiwan, as well as colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIV).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don’t hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible and no later than the 16th of November.

If you have any questions regarding the position or practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.
